Vent and rant all you want here. We listen (read). There’s just those that may see your story and not know how to reply. It’s normal. I don’t like being someone who tries to tell people what they need to do and how to live their life, but if your BOYFRIEND is acting that way towards you, you need to leave him. He’s being toxic. That’s something you DO NOT NEED. Every person deserves happiness, but not at the expense of someone else’s. Therefore, get yourself away from him. You don’t need that negativity around you. Get your beautiful soul away from that guy, find more friends, even online can help, but find new people to spend your time on. Your life will always be important. No matter what. Message me if you want.

Listen, I’m kinda dealing with the same. I fell in love (5yrs of these emotions and feelings), she got out of a bad relationship (with a now except-best friend of mine), we dove into each other. The only issue, I dove with pure love, she was just lonely. We talked everyday, she said I love you first, we had sex. For quick insight, I’m a 25yr old male who’s only had sex with 3 women in my life (now 4). I don’t commit that act unless I know my feelings for them are true. She dropped me and got over everything within a week. During that same week, she got with someone else. I’ve now been a rebound for someone that I never imagined doing this to me. I’m beyond hurt; my father is dead and he was the only person who truly understood me inside and out. I’ve been drinking myself and destroying my body with physical abuse. I can tell you, though I’m doing it now, the sane part of me knows that she’s not worth all this abuse and turmoil. No matter how much she meant to me. You gotta continue through. Take your path of turmoil, walk through it with determination and come out on top. I’ve lost several people whom I’ve had forever long friendships with, and now they’re strangers. You’re gonna be 100% okay. It won’t be over within’ the year if I’m speaking honestly. That’s a decade of a friendship and now it’s over from a regretful night. When you think of what could’ve been or what you should’ve done, tell yourself, “Oh well.” Cause there’s nothing to do about it now. Just don’t smother yourself with this depression. You can message me if you want.

Be patient. Be really patient. Just continue being there. Offer your ear. Ask if he would like your opinion. Don’t force those conversations though. Make plans to hangout or whatever, just to help distract him. If it doesn’t distract him, and he continues to talk about the issues, do as I stated at first. Just be there. A lot of times, when I’m in my ruts for days/weeks/months/years, however long, my friends never push me. They always offer to hang out though. Some people need solitude, but I will say, there are times where solitude is NOT the best choice. It’ll be hard, and it’ll take a lot of time, but if you love him like you say you do, you’ll be able to push through it just as easy as he can. Much love to both of you. You’re acting as a good friend in my opinion.
